articleTitle: Characteristics of two dimensional phase coupled array of vertical cavity surface emitting GaAs/AlAaAs lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Two dimensional 3x3 coupled arrays of GaAs/AlGaAs vertical cavity surface emitting lasers (VCSELs) with 7 μm center to center spacing are described [l]. The VCSELs emit normal to the epitaxial surface of the wafer and their compact size, simplicity of fabrication and low threshold per laser makes them ideal for the array geometry. Earlier VCSELs had larger spacings between lasers and were not coupled [2,3].

articleTitle: Tunable three-section, strained MQW, PA-DFB's with large single mode tuning range (72 A) and narrow linewidth (around 1 Mhz)
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Tunable three-section, phase-adjusted DFB’s with a strained MQW active layer were realized. The paper describes the fabrication and the measured device characteristics. This includes a description of the operating principles, driving conditions and e.g. (measured) mode-boundaries in the three-dimensional space of the three driving currents.

articleTitle: High power CW operation of aluminium-free InGaAs/GaAs/InGaP strained layer single quantum well ridge waveguide lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: In the present paper Ino.49Ga0. 51P was used in place of AlGaAs for the first time (InGaAs/GaAs/InGaP, hereafter).

articleTitle: Semiconductor photonic integrated circuit for high-density WDM light source
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Recent progress in semiconductor optical devices and their fabricatin technique has brought about a possibility to develop various kinds of semiconductor photonic integrated circuits (SPICs) [1,2]. We report, here, a 1.5um range four-channel light source SPIC, which consists of four wavelength-tunable LDs and four light intensity modulators and two waveguide couplers, aming at high-density WDM optical system application.

articleTitle: Passive mode locking in a short-cavity diode laser
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We report passive mode locking in AZGaAs/GaAs heterostruoture laser with 200 μm cavity length. The pulse width of less than 1 ps at nearly 200 GHe repetition rate was obtained.

articleTitle: Resistance to external optical feedback in a gain-coupled semiconductor dfb laser
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Conventional index-coupled (IC) distributed feedback (DFB) lasers are so sensitive to reflected light that they require costly optical isolators. This also tends to prevent integration of DFB lasers with other optical components

articleTitle: Partly gain-coupled versus /spl lambda//4-shifted DFB laser: a comparison
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Theoretical comparison of partly gain-coupled DFB laser with λ/4-shifted DFB laser in terms of yield, spatial hole burning, non-linearities and feedback sensitivity.

articleTitle: Low threshold CW operation in a novel gain-coupled distributed feedback semiconductor laser
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Two major advantages of the distributed feedback (DFB) laser operating on the basis of gain coupling (GC) are single-longitudinal-mode property without any phase shifting structures, and immunity to facet reflection [1,2].

articleTitle: 633 nm CW operation of GaInP/AlGaInP laser-diodes
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Visible light emitting lasers (λ ~ 600 - 680 nm) are attractive for optical recording, printing, and as a replacement for He-Ne gas-lasers.

articleTitle: Analysis of wavelength chirping for /spl lambda//4 shifted dfb ld considering spatial hole-burning along cavity
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Wavelength chirping in directly modulated DFB LDs is a main factor limiting transmission distance in Gb/s range optical fiber communications, due to chromatic dispersion problem.

articleTitle: Submilliampere threshold 1.5 /spl mu/m strained-layer multiple quantum well lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Low threshold lasers are attractive for parallel optical interconnects with low power consumption for switching and supercomputer applications. The combination of bi-axial strain and quantum confinement has been proposed to reduce the in-plane hole effective mass such that the laser threshold current, Auger recombination and intervalence band absorption are reduced.

articleTitle: Simple in-line bi-directional 1.5/spl mu/m/1.3 /spl mu/m transceivers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We propose some simple new single-waveguide in-line photonic integrated circuit (PIC) architectures for 1.3μm/ 1.5μm WDM bi-directional (duplex) transmission.

articleTitle: Carrier induced differential refractive index and detuning effect in GaInAsP Scmqw lasers with 3,5 and 9 wells
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: It is well established [1-2] that quantum well lasers can achieve very low spectral linewidth due to a much larger differential gain leading to a reduction of the linewidth enhancement factor.

articleTitle: Carrier lifetime and linewidth enhancement factor measurements from cross-modulation characteristics in semiconductor optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: This paper describes the theoretical analysis and experiment of cross-amplitude-modulation (XAM) and cross-phase-modulation (XPM) in semiconductor optical amplifiers which have an active structure of semiconductor lasers. From this work, the basic laser parameters such as carrier lifetime and linewidth enhancement factor can be determined as a function of the carrier density from the same device, since the carrier density is not clamped in traveling-wave semiconductor optical amplifiers.

articleTitle: Narrow spectral linewidth (170 khz) long-cavity corrugation-pitch-modulated MQW-DFB laser
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Long cavity MQW-DFB lasers (l), (2) are promising in getting sub-MHz spectral linewidth. In this paper, a corrugation-pitch-modulated (CPM) structure (3) is introduced to long-cavity MQW-DFB lasers. A spectral linewidth of 170 kHz is achieved at 25 mW output power. This linewidth is the narrowest ever obtained.

articleTitle: AlGaInP visible laser diodes grown on misoriented substrates
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: AlGaInP laser diodes grown by metal organic chemical vaper deposition (MOCVD) with GaInP active layers have been practically applied in the lasing wavelength range of 667-680nm.

articleTitle: Analysis of gain and dynamics in quantum-well and quantum-wire lasers using accurate line shape functions
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: In this paper we discuss gain and dynamic properties of InGaAs/InP quantum-well (QW) and quantum-wire lasers using realistic line shape functions. The line shape functions which describe homogeneous broadenings are obtained by means of a theory l)involving non-Markovian relaxation processes of the optical dipole moment.

articleTitle: Performance enhancement of InGaAs/InP quantum well lasers by both tensile and compressive strain
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We report a remarkable improvement in strained InGaAs/InP quantum well (QW) lasers both for Fabry-Perot (F-P) and DFB lasers grown by MOVPE, due to the reduced internal loss for both tensile and compressive strain. F-P-QW lasers with tensile strain show highest output power over 200 mW whereas in DFB lasers, an output of 100 mW in single longitudinal mode was observed.

articleTitle: 3.8nm continuous tuning range of a low threshold distributed bragg reflector laser
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Wavelength tunable semiconductor lasers are required as sources for coherent and high density WDM optical communication systems and also as local oscillators in coherent optical systems. The larger the wavelength tuning without mode hopping, the greater the number of wavelength/frequency multiplexed channels which can be accommodated. We have fabricated and characterized a three section Distributed Bragg Reflector (DBR) laser with 3.8nm continuous tunability and a wavelength coverage of 8.4nm.

articleTitle: Integrated interferometric injection lasers (/spl lambda/ =1300 nm and 1500 nm) with tuning range exceeding 20 nm
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: In this contribution we report on first integrated Y-coupled cavity lasers (YCCL) with tuning ranges exceeding 20 nm for both the 1300 nm and 1500 nm wavelength regime.

articleTitle: High temperature operation of InGaAs strained quantum well lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Strained quantum well (SQW) laser structures have been investigated for military avionics applications requiring high-temperature performance.

articleTitle: Low-threshold current and high-efficiency operation of electro-absorption modulator/DFB laser light source with AR-HR coating
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Insertion loss of the modulator has been investigated in the monolithically integrated electro-absorption modulator/DFB laser light source, and low-threshold current and high-efficiency operation has been attained in the monolithic device by AR-HR coating on the facets.

articleTitle: Narrow-linewidth, low threshold vertical-cavity surface-emitting lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We report for the first time linewidth measurements of a strained quantum well (SQW) vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser (VCSEL). A straight-forward. high yield process was used to fabricate sub milliamp threshold current CW VCSELs.

articleTitle: Longitudinal spatial hole burning reduction using quantum size effect in MQW-/spl lambda//4-shifted DFB lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Longitudinal spatial hole burning (LSHB) in 1/4-shifted DFB lasers has been one of the most serious problems, which deteriorates not only static[l] but also dynamic single mode properties such as the increment of wavelength chirping.

articleTitle: Optoelectronic integrated circuits for telephony/broadband passive optical (TPON/BPON) networks: design and experimental results
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The objective of this work is to develop a high yield, process tolerant optoelectronic integration scheme and to apply this to circuits for optical subscriber access links. The advantages of using optoelectronic integrated circuits (OEICs) in such applications are potentially low cost, flexibility in optical circuit function and minimal size.

articleTitle: Vertically-stacked multiple quantum wire semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We report the structure and the lasing characteristics of GaAs/AlGaAs vertically-stacked multiple quantum wire (QWR) semiconductor lasers which exhibit improved performance compared to single QWR devices.

articleTitle: The Temperature Dependence of the Threshold Current for InGaAlP Visible Light Lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The temperature dependence of the threshold current for InGaAlP visible light laser diodes was investigated from the aspect of gain-current characteristics. Systematic experimental nor theoretical gain-current characteristics of this material have never been reported, which are indispensable for designing low threshold current and high temperature cw operation of InGaAlP lasers.

articleTitle: Frequency modulation and linewidth of gain-levered 2-section single quantum well lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: It was shown that based on the highly sublinear nature of the gain versus carrier density characteristics of single quantum well (SQW) lasers, one can obtain a large change in the carrier density in one section of the baser by a small change in injection current in the other[l,2].

articleTitle: Wavelength tuning efficiency and spectral linewidth broadening in tunable twin-guide dfb laser diodes
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Continuously wavelength tunable laser diodes with integrated tuning regions, such as 3-section DBR lasers or tunable twin-guide (TTG) DFB lasers, often show a steep increase of the spectral linewidth while being tuned /1,2/.

articleTitle: Dependence of characteristics of buried grating type distributed feedback laser diodes on the coupling constant
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The coupling constant k L is the most important parameter of the DFB-LDs. However there have been very few reports so far on the relation between the characteristics of the DFB-LDs and k L because of the difficulty of the control of k L.

articleTitle: Integration of 1.3 micron wavelength lasers and amplifiers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Integration of lasers and optical amplifiers has been demonstrated in photonic integrated circuits (PIC'S) [1] using an amplifier to compensate for optical losses that occur in a complex optical circuit.

articleTitle: High static performance GaInAs/GaInAsP SCH MQW 1.5/spl mu/m wavelength buried ridge stripe lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The objective of this paper is to experimentally demonstrate the potential advantages of GaInAs/InP Multi-Quantum Well (MQW) structure over bulk material for improving the static properties of Buried Heterostructure (BH) lasers.

articleTitle: Radiative and non-radiative recombination mechanisms in 1.5/spl mu/m MQW lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The performance of long-wavelength multiple quantum well lasers has improved significantly in recent years, with reported high quantum efficiencies, low threshold currents, and high differential gain.

articleTitle: Reliability of high-power AlGaAs SQW grinsch lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Summary form only given. Detailed analysis of the change of the electro-optical performance of AIGaAs SQW GRINSCH lasers during life test enables a careful assessment of the reliability limits of these devices with respect to their applicability in optical data communication and optical data storage systems.

articleTitle: Picosecond gain dynamics of 1.5-g/spl mu/m multiple quantum well optical amplifiers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The purpose of this paper is the demonstration of picosecond gain dynamics in 1.5-pm multiple quantum well (MQW) optical amplifiers and the identification of the physical mechanisms which govern the gain dynamics.

articleTitle: Narrow linewidth multi-electrode monolithic external cavity DFB laser incorporating a phase modulator giving 2nm continuous tuning
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Narrow linewidth, wavelength tunable semiconductor laser diodes are important devices for the practical realization of coherent optical communication systems. Linewidths less than lMHz can be readily obtained with a DFB laser monolithically integrated with an external cavity. However, such devices show periodic linewidth broadening and mode hops with increasing laser current due to variation in the feedback phase, and cannot be tuned while maintaining a narrow linewidth [1]. We report here a novel multi-electrode monolithic external cavity DFB laser incorporating a phase modulator which gives a narrow linewidth for more than 2nm continous tuning.

articleTitle: High power SCH-SQW InGaAsP/GaAs laser diodes without DLD-induced sudden mode failures
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: This paper describes the results of short period life tests of λ=0.81μm SCH-SQW InGaAsP/Gals laser intended for operation as the pumping sources for Solid state YAG:Nd lasers and presents preliminary data on degradation processes under high optical excitation in the corresponding SCH-SQW InGaAsP/GaAs heterostructures

articleTitle: Injection locking properties of DFB semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Injection locking is a promising method which can be used in multi-channel coherent optical communications. The tendency of multi-longitudinal mode operation in FP semiconductor lasers prevents, however, extensive use of this technique.

articleTitle: Surface emitting laser arrays with uniformly separated wavelengths
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Recently, there has been intensive research on vertical-cavity surface-emitting (VC-SE) lasers. The VC-SE lasers are promising because the processing is wafer-scale and cost-effective, and high packing density as well as low threshold current can be obtained. For applications in optical signal processing optical interconnects, optical neural networks, and optical communications using wavelength division multiplexing (WDM), it is important to obtain a 2-dimensional (2-D) array of monolithically integrated multiple wavelength lasers.

articleTitle: Window-structure InGaALP visible light laser diodes by self-selective diffusion induced disordering
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: High power operation of short wavelength laser diodes is very important in applications such as laser printers and optical disc systems.

articleTitle: Relative and absolute timing jitter in actively mode-locked semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: This paper discusses the magnitude and origin of the pulse-to-pulse timing jitter that is added to that of the modulating source by actively mode-locked lasers.

articleTitle: Full wafer processing and testing the future of large scale laser fabrication
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Today's fabrication techniques for semiconductor lasers differ significantly from the VLSI-type processing used in semiconductor circuit technology. This is mainly due to the use of cleaving techniques for the formation of the laser mirrors. Lasers fabricated by cleaving can not be integrated with other optoelectronic or electronic devices on the same chip. In addition, processes like mirror coating and testing have to be done at the bar or single diode level. This results in considerable yield reduction (handling) and increased fabrication/ testing costs.

articleTitle: Submilliampere-threshold multi-quantum-well AlGaAs lasers without facet coating
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: An ultra low threshold current of 0.88mA was obtained for three-quantum-well AlGaAs lasers without facet coating under continuous wave (CW) operation at room temperature.

articleTitle: Tunable wavelength emission of a 3-mirror vertical cavity surface emitting laser
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: There has been many publications on vertical cavity surface emitting (VC-SE) lasers'I2 for numerous applications in optical communications and optical signal processing. In this work, we report for the first time tunable wavelength emission from a 3-mirror VC-SE laser. The laser requires only one drive source and uniform wavelength tuning is achieved with the feedback from the third mirror in the VC-SE laser.

articleTitle: The static and dynamic characteristics of single and multiple phase jump DFB laser structures
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Detailed modelling and experimental work has been performed to optimise the static and dynamic performance of single and multiple phase jump DFB laser structures.

articleTitle: Picosecond, high power pulse generation by actively mode-locked two section semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The generation of optical pulses with short durations below 4 ps and high peak powers of more than 900 mW at repetition rates of 500 MHz/sec is demonstrated by means of actively mode-locked two section semiconductor lasers. Time-bandwidth product widening is explained as due to self-phase modulation.

articleTitle: High gain strained-layer InGaAs/InGaAsP MQW laser amplifiers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: This contribution is the first report on the use of modulation-doped strained-layer InGaAs/InGaAsP quantum wells in 1.5 μm wavelength laser amplifiers.

articleTitle: High power 0.98 /spl mu/m InGaAs-GaAs strained layer buried heterostructure lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The objective of this work is to demonstrate a high power fundamental mode index guided laser emitting at λ = 0.98 pm and suitable for coupling pump power into erbium-doped optical fibers.

articleTitle: Multiple-wavelength array of buried heterostructure lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The objective of this work is to demonstrate a monolithic array of low-threshold index-guided diode lasers made from material containing an active layer whose bandgap has been laterally graded by in situ processing during growth.

articleTitle: A low threshold current 1.5/spl mu/m AlGaInAs/InGaAs MQW laser and its complete disordering by ZN diffusion
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Much attention has been paid on AlGaTnAs/InGaAs material lattice matched to TnP. since this covers the wavelength range of 1.3-2.55 μm.

articleTitle: Narrow spectral linewidth, high output power operation and FM response characteristics in 1.5 /spl mu/m butt-jointed DBR lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: In the coherent optical communication systems, the narrow spectral linewidth, high output power and tunable laser diode is required as a light source. FM response characteristics are also important for a transmitter LD in FSK systems. In this paper, we present two types of Df3R LDs which show suitable characteristics for a local oscillator(TypeA) and for a transmitter(TypeB).

articleTitle: High quality index guided ridge AlGaInP/GaInP visible lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The fabrication and characteristics of high performaancc index guided visible AlGalnlP/GalnlP double heterostructure and of graded index separate confinement quantum well ridge laser diodes are reported paying special attention to transversal and longitudinal mode as well as noise properties.

articleTitle: Threshold-current-analysis of InGaAs/InGaAsP multi-quantum-well-separate- confinement-lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Multi-quantum-well (MQW) laser diodes are expected to be superior to conventional double-heterostructure (DH) laser diodes as far as threshold current density (Jth), temperature behaviour (To) and frequency response are concerned. InGaAsflnP MQW lasers with 1.5 μm emission wavelength did not yet show lower threshold current density than corresponding quaternary DH laser diodes, while separate optical confinement (SC) MQW laser structures appeared to be more promising.

articleTitle: Recent progress in narrow-linewidth ingaasp laser diodes and diode laser amplifiers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Advanced diode laser applications, such as coherent optical communications /l/, require devices with a stable single mode emission, a narrow spectral linewidth and occassionally, the ability of electronic wavelength tuning.

articleTitle: GaAs vertical-short-cavity top-surface emitting lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Vertical short-cavity surface emitting laser diodes (SELDs) were studied [l-41 due to their unique properties for a wide-variety of device applications such as two-dimensional arrays, optically integrated devices, optical interconnection systems, etc.

articleTitle: Measurement of the gain saturation spectrum in InGaAsP diode lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The origin of nonlinear gain suppression in InGaAsP lasers is analyzed by a new experimental approach sensitive to small gain changes.

articleTitle: High performance 10/sup 0/ angle-facet laser amplifiers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The first 10° angle-facet semiconductor laser amplifiers (SLA's), with facet reflectivities as low as 10-5 are described. These reflectivities improve the obtained for 7° angle-facet SLA's [U, [21. Further, in support of the 10" angle the influence of the facet angle on coupling efficiency and gain ripple is analysed both theoretically and experimentally.

articleTitle: Observation of 10 db squeezing in semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: It was believed among physicists and quantum electronics engineers that an ideal laser generates a coherent state of light. According to the quantum theory of photodetection, the shot noise appearing in intensity and phase measurements for a laser light can be attributed to the quantum noise of the laser light. Two of the present authors (S. M. and Y. Y.) and 0.

articleTitle: An analytic expression for intensity- and frequency noise of semiconductor lasers within the coherence-collapse-regime
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: It is well known that semiconductor lasers exhibit tremendous intensity- and frequency noise, if they are operated above a certain optical feedback level /1, 2/ in the "coherence-collapse"-regime /3/.

articleTitle: Improved mass-transported GaInP/GaAs lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Buried-heterostructure (BH) lasers have been fabricated in GaInP/GaAs double-heterostructure (DH) wafers using mass transport.

articleTitle: SQH-SQW InGaAsP/GaAs (/spl lambda/=0.81 /spl mu/m) single-stripe laser with 4.3W CW power
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: This paper reports a 4.3W CW output for InGaAsP/GaAs SCH-SQW laser emitting at a shorter wavelength (λ=0.8lμm) which provides the possibility of the application for solid state laser pumping.

articleTitle: Threshold reduction and CW operation of LPE grown GaInAsP/AlGaAs red-light injection lasers with the 670nm wavelength
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The objective of this paper is to report a remarkable threshold current density reduction (~ 1KA/cm2) of 670nm wavelength GaInAsP/AlGaAs lasers[l], and the room temperature CW operation of the GaInAsP/AlGaAs VSIS laser

articleTitle: Linewidth broadening of quantum-well-SCH lasers enhanced by carrier fluctuation in optical guiding layers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Reduction of the spectral linewidth in semiconductor injection lasers is an important subject for further development of the optical communication and the optical measuring technologies. In this paper, we point out a mechanism giving extra broadening of the linewidth in Quantum-Well-SCH lasers, and propose a reduction method of the linewidth. This extra broadening is due to carrier fluctuation in the optical guiding layers and becomes more remarkable when the injected carriers overflow to the optical guiding layers in lasers with smaller number of the quantum well, and can be suppressed by introduction of the so called potential controlled [1] or modulation-doped [2] structure.

articleTitle: Crystal growth, new structures and integration
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Advances of semiconductor lasers are indebted much to crystal growth technology. Innovative performances are closely related to laser structures. Integration of lasers are hot subjects in this research areas. Recent progress of crystal growth, new structures and integration will be reviewed.

articleTitle: Operation of a strained-layer distributed-feedback surface-emitting laser
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: To develop high-power InGaAs/GaAs strained-layer DFB surface-emitting (GSE) lasers and laser arrays.

articleTitle: High-power diffraction-limited operation from 20- and 40-element phase-locked arrays of antiguides
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Monolithic phase-locked arrays without active phase control are sought as reliable sources of high coherent powers (>100 mW). Phase-locked arrays of antiguides 1 are very attractive candidates, since they combine strong overall interelement coupling with strong optical-mode confinement.

articleTitle: Picosecond switching dynamics and bistable-wavelength-latch operation of a two-segment DFB laser
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We report spectrally resolved measurement of picosecond set-reset wavelength switching of a wavelength-bistable two-segment DFB laser.

articleTitle: SLM capability of 1.5/spl mu/m DFB lasers with a narrow stripe region
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We report excellent SLM (single longitudinal mode) behavior of novel phase-shift DFB lasers which have a narrow stripe region. Phase-shift DFB lasers are at present widely known for their excellent SLM capability at threshold current. However, the SLM capability is likely to be deteriorated by axial hole-burning above the threshold current[ 11. In addition, some particular techniques are required for fabricating the phase-shifts directly into the corrugations.

articleTitle: Linewidth and FM noise spectrum of DFB lasers including spatial holeburning and nonlinear gain
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: In this paper we show theoretically, how the conventional linewidth formula should be modified for DFB lasers to account for spatial holeburning and nonlinear gain, and the consequences for the FM noise spectrum.

articleTitle: Investigation of the temperature dependence of the threshold current density of GaInP/AlGaInP double heterostructure lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Objective: The objective of this paper is an investigation of the temperature dependence of the threshold current density of GaInP/AlGaInP red emitting lasers with special emphasis on the increased temperature dependence at higher temperature.

articleTitle: A real-index guided InGaAlP visible laser diode with a small beam astigmatism
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The objective of this work is to realize a low-astigmatism InGaAP visible laser diode by using a self-aligned real-index guided structure.

articleTitle: 1.5/spl mu/ InGaAs/InGaAsP separate confinement multi-quantum well lasers grown by chemical beam epitaxy
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We report the first preparation of high quality InGaAs/InGaAsP multi-quantum well lasers having a standard separate confinement heterostructure (SCH) by chemical beam epitaxy (CBE).

articleTitle: Room temperature vertical cavity GaAs/AlGaAs surface emitting injection laser
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We present a surface emitting injection laser (SEIL) that can be operated quasi CW at room temperature and can be mounted with the substrate down. The elimination of backetching of the substrate enhances strongly the structural integrity and facilitates array fabrication.

articleTitle: Threshold power reduction of GaAs-AlGaAs ridge SQW-GRINSCH laser diodes through photon-recycling
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: A 42% reduction of the threshold input power of an AlGaAs/GaAs laser diode, based on photon rccycling (P.R.) of the spontancous emission, has been demonstrated for the first time.

articleTitle: Gain and spontaneous emission measurements in GaAlAs quantum well lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We report on measurements of spontaneous emission and gain in GaAlAs quantum well (QW) lasers which clearly illustrate the reduced dimensionality of the active layer.

articleTitle: Carrier recombination rates in GaAs/AlGaAs and strained InGaAs/GaAs quantum wells under high levels of excitation
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: To study the carrier recombination processes in GaAs-AlGaAs and strained InGaAsGaAs single-quantum-well lasers under high levels of excitation.

articleTitle: Very high power (500mW) AlGaAs SQW grinsch ridge laser with frequency doubled output (40mW at 428nm)
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We report the performance and fabrication characteristics of an AlGaAs SQW GRINSC€I ridge single device lasers with a maximum, thermally limited output power of up to 500mW and fundamental transverse mode operation up to 360mW. Excellent optical beam properties, as very low optical phase distortion and astigmatism, at very high power levels are demonstrated and allowed the efficient (40%) generation of 40mW blue radiation at 428nm by frequency doubling in KNbO3.

articleTitle: Band-mixing effect on TE- and TM-optical gains in AlGaAs/GaAs BH SQW lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We report on band-mixing effect evidence in TE- and TM- optical gain measured in AlGaAs/GaAs EH SQW 1-asers under different pump currents.

articleTitle: Consideration on intensity noise of GaAlAs/GaAs surface emitting laser
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The relative intensity noise (RIN) of a vertical cavity surface emitting (SE) laser diode was measured to be less than -140 dB/Hz. The RIN was characterized in terms of polarization. Some theoretical discussion was made for the excitation dependence of RIN.

articleTitle: Coherent linear and two-dimensional grating-surface-emitting multi-quantum-well arrays emitting at 1.5/spl mu/m
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The objective of this work is to demonstrate coherent, mutual-injection-coupled emission at 1.5 μm from linear and two-dimensional grating-surface-emitting arrays.

articleTitle: High power operation of GaAs and AlGaAs single quantum well broad-area laser diodes for Nd: YAG laser pumping
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The highest output power of 2.9W and the highest output power of 2.6W were obtained for GaAs and AlGaAs single stripe quantum well laser diodes (LDs) at about 808nm in CW condition. The reduction of their threshold currents and increase of their quantum efficiencies by employing the single quantum well (SQW) separate confinement heterostructure, and the optimization of their facet reflectivities have been done to achive these values. Stable operations were also confirmed for exceeding 1000 hours under the condition of 1W.35 C.

articleTitle: Two terminal, single quantum well, double heterostructure optoelectronic switch (does) laser
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The Double Heterostructure Optoelectronic switch (DOES) is a bistable switching device with considerable potential for optoelectronic integration. In broad area, graded index single quantum well (GRIN SQW) configuration, lasing properties comparable to conventional diode lasers have been demonstrated(1). Buried Heterostructure (BH) devices have now been fabricated and characterised for both DC and AC operation.

articleTitle: Dependence of noise on bandwidth in DFB laser amplifiers used as active filters
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser

articleTitle: 780nm AlGaAs high-power lasers and their reliable operation
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: A high-power and short-wavelength laser is required for application to optical information processing systems such as optical disk filing equipment. At present, an AlGaAs ternary alloy is the most practical material for providing a high-power light source. In this paper, we demonstrate a reliable 780nm AlGaAs high power laser.

articleTitle: 1.53 /spl mu/m InGaAsP/InP first order /spl lambda//4 shifted DFB lasers with high coupling coefficients
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We experimentally and theoretically studied coupling coefficients K as high as 300 cm-l and found lower feedback sensitivity, lower influence on facet reflectivity and excellent high frequency behaviour without any penalty in mode jumps.

articleTitle: Tunable wavelength filter using tunable twin-guide-(TTG-) laser
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: A tunable optical filter is a key device for wavelength division multiplexing systems. Such a filter could be used in a receiver and as a wavelength division switch that selects optical wavelength.

articleTitle: Colliding pulse mode-locked quantum-well lasers on a single chip
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We report the generation of short optical pulses from a novel monolithic colliding pulse mode-locked quantum well lasers. Transform-limited pulses with durations of 1.4 picosecond have been achieved at repetition rates of 32.6 and 40 GHz.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a two wavelength multichannel grating cavity laser
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: A new form of diode laser source has been developed for use in wavelength division multiplexing applications where a large number of spectral channels with spacings of greater than 1 nm are required.

articleTitle: Wavelength tuning in high power InGaAs/AlGaAs lasers grown on nonplanar substrates
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Strained-layer InGaAs/AlGaAs QW lasers represent a relatively new class of laser devices in the wavelength region around 1 pm where they provide a practical and inexpensive pump source for Erbium doped fiber amplifiers as well as a high power source for second harmonic generation in KTP-crystals.

articleTitle: A new density matrix theory on semiconductor lasers considering non-Markoffian intraband relaxation
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We have derived new density matrix equations for semiconductor laser gain from the microscopic Hamiltonian considering non-Markoffian intraband relaxation to treat nonlinear and ultra-fast phenomena.

articleTitle: InGaAs/InP distributed feedback quantum well lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We describe InGaAs/InP multiquantum well distributed feedback (DFB) lasers with novel properties attributable to the quantum well based active layer. Laser structures were grown by atmospheric pressure metalorganic vapor phase epitaxy (MOVPE) on first order gratings fabricated in the substrate.

articleTitle: A scheme of high power, ultrashort pulse generation using pulse - biased diode laser amplifier
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: To achieve higher peak power with very narrow pulse width from a laser diode, use of a highly excited laser diode amplifier should be promising(l), (2). To get the maximum differential gain while minimizing amplified spontaneous emission, a scheme of power amplification is investigated, where the amplifier itself is pulse-pumped, with signal pulse incident at proper timing. Using this scheme it is expected that pumping current can be set to exceed the threshold level as far as incident pulse arrives earlier than turn-on delay time.

articleTitle: Quantum well lasers for optoelectronic integration grown by laser assisted atomic layer epitaxy
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Integrated optoelectronic components such as addressable laser arrays and transmitter and receiver arrays require the development of selective epitaxy processes for the definition of device elements on the wafer surface.

articleTitle: Investigation of the mirror temperature of narrowstripe GaAs/AlGaAs quantum well lasers with segmented contacts
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: 1.) It is demonstrated that the mirror temperature of AIGaAs-lasers can be significantly reduced by applying a suitable electrical potential to separated contacts in the mirror region.

articleTitle: Power independent degradation of high power GaAlAs lasers with nonabsorbing-mirrors
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: This paper reports a notable observation that degradation in high power GaAlAs lasers with nonabosrbing mirrors which we fabricated is practically independent of output power in remarkable contrast with the conventional lasers. Thus high output power can be obtained without sacrifice of reliability.

articleTitle: A novel single-mode high-power three-segmented LOC GaAlAs/GaAs laser
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: In this paper, a novel LOC: taser-channeled twin-ridge substrate three-segmented LOC (CTRS-TSLOC GaAlAs/GaAs laser is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Lasing characteristics of quantum wire lasers: tight binding analysis
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We applied the tight binding method to the analysis of lasing characteristics of quantum wire lasers.

articleTitle: Fabrication and characteristics of GaAs/AlGaAs tunable laser diodes with DBR and phase control regions integrated by compositional disordering of quantum well
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: This paper reports on the fabrication process using ion implantation, two-step MOVPE growth and electron beam lithography, and the characteristics of GaAs/AlGaAs tunable DBR lasers.

articleTitle: Room temperature CW operation of all-MOCVD-grown SQW lasers on Si using AlGaAs/AlGaP intermediate layers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: All of room temperature CW operating lasers have been directly grown (twostep growth technique) on Si by combination of MBE and MOCVD techniques [l]. However, the GaAs/Si grown by the two-step growth technique still have the problems, such as the roughness of the surface morphology and Si autodoping in the GaAs layers.

articleTitle: Theoretical analysis of nonlinear gain effects in InGaAsP/InP quantum well lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We theoretically discuss the nonlinear gain effects in InGaAsP/InP quantum well (QW) lasers comparing to those in GaAs/AlGaAs QW lasers. In addition, effects of the nonlinear gain on the differential gain and the linewidth enhancement factor are examined.

articleTitle: Dependence of the k-factor on differential gain: implications for ultimate modulation performance of semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: In semiconductor lasers, it is well known that the damping rate y is proportional to the photon density S, while the resonance frequency fo is proportional to S1/2.

articleTitle: In-phase operation of high power, nonplanar periodic laser arrays
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: The objective of this work is to demonstrate the in-phase operation to high optical powers of a nonplanar periodic laser array.

articleTitle: Gain and absorption in InGaAs/InGaAsP and InGaAs/InGaAlAs SCMQW laser structures
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We have studied the optical gain and absorption processes in InGaAs/InGaAlAs and InGaAs/InGaAsP SCMQW laser structures, allowing us to predict the laser threshold and high speed performance.

articleTitle: CW operating characteristics of coherent two-dimensional grating-surface-emitting diode laser arrays
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Obtain highly coherent, single mode operation in a monolithic, two-dimensional, Grating-Surface-Emitting (GSE) laser array.

articleTitle: A high-power short-pulse laser diode for an SHG pumping source
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: This paper reports a high-power short-pulse laser diode in which we obtained maximum peak power as high as 2.4W under fundamental mode operation for the first time. High-power optical pulse is generated by use of modified buried-twin-ridge substrate (BTRS)1) structure which incorporates the saturable absorption region in the active layer near the cavity end region , whereby efficient gain-switching is attained.

articleTitle: Influence of the P type doping of the InP cladding layer on the threshold current density in 1.5/spl mu/m Q.W. lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We have studied (experimentally and theoretically) the influence of the p type doping of the InP cladding layer on the differential external efficiency T-~D and on the threshold current density Jth in 1.5 μm InGaAs-InGaAsP-InP quantum well (QW) lasers.

articleTitle: Novel window-structure algainp visible LDs with non-absorbing facets formed by disordering of natural superlattice in gainp active layer
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: High power visible AlGaInP laser diodes (LDs) have been desired for use in optical-disk memory systems and many other applications.

articleTitle: Waveguiding and spectral characteristics of InGaAs/AlGaAs strained single quantum well lasers (/spl lambda/ /spl tilde/ 1/spl mu/m)
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser

articleTitle: Performance of tunable DBR-lasers with different waveguide joints
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Here, we present the fabrication and measured performance of three types of wavelength tunable three-electrode DBR-lasers, having different waveguide joint structures.

articleTitle: Generation of 170 Ghz optical sidebands of a single mode semiconductor laser by nonlinear intracavity interaction
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We demonstrate the generation of optical sidebands with a frequency separation of 170 GHz by nonlinear optical interaction of light from a 1.3 /spl mu/m DFB laser with the population pulsations of the longitudinal mode beatings of a broad area laser.

articleTitle: Novel active-filter-type wavelength-tunable laser diodes
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: This paper proposes a novel wavelength-tunable laser diode which utilizes an active transmission filter of a λ/4-shifted grating.

articleTitle: Tm-mode gain enhancement in InGaAs/InP lasers with tensile strained-layer superlattice
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We present TM-mode gain enhancement of strained-layer superlattice (SLS) lasers and its application for a polarization-insensitive laser amplifier.

articleTitle: Wavelength control of picosecond pulses (/spl tilde/ 10 psec) in quantum well lasers by localized and unlocalized pumping pulses
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We demonstrate a novel method to control the lasing wavelength of picosecond pulses generated in a gain-switched quantum well (QW) laser using both localized and unlocalized pumping pulses, showing possibilities to apply these phenomena to ultrafast logic gating operations

articleTitle: A fundamental limit for the feedback sensitivity of semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: It is the purpose of this paper to derive a fundamental limit for the feedback sensitivity and to discuss the impact of this limit on laser design.

articleTitle: Effect of frequency chirping on soliton tansmission using semiconductor lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Soliton transmission with semiconductor source is of current interest. However, the generation of short pulses from semiconductor laser is always accompanied by an inherent red-shift frequency chirping. In the soliton transmission experiments to date[1], extensive efforts have been made to reduce the chirping and to achieve the transform limited pulses. No investigation of frequency chirping on soliton formation and propagation has been carried out except an theoretical analysis of chirped soliton pulses in an ideal lossless fiber [2]. In this paper we present an experimental study of the influence of chirping on the soliton propagation in optical fiber.

articleTitle: Spectral characteristics of distributed reflector (dr) lasers
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We describe lasing characteristics of 1.5μm wavelength GaInAsP/InP distributed reflector (DR) type lasers including higher efficiency, better single mode and narrower linewidth properties than those of DFB lasers fabricated on the same wafer.

articleTitle: Analytical and numerical treatment of sub-ps pulse generation by active mode locking
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: We present an analytical treatment of active mode locking of a semiconductor laser amplifier ( SCLA ) in an external cavity and compare the result to a full, numerical analysis. The pulse shaping mechanisms are calculated in detail, using a correct Lorentzian shape for the gain curve.

articleTitle: Performance and reliability of 1.3 /spl mu/m DFB lasers designed for CATV applications
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: Recent progress in the development of semiconductor lasers for analog modulation has permitted the production of devices with capabilities close to the fundamental limits for CATV applications. Only a few years ago, almost all InP-based lasers were designed with digital telecommunications systems in mind; analog applications were rare and specialized. However, fiber optics offers significant advantages to the cable television network, especially if systems using the standard amplitude modulation scheme are employed. Among these is the ability to replace a long string of amplifiers with a single link, offering better signal quality and reliability. Current product can transmit from 40 to 80 NTSC channels simultaneously over links from 10 to 20 km long. Fueled by this capability, a significant worldwide market is emerging.

articleTitle: A high-power GaAlAs superluminescent diode with an anti-reflective window structure
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: A high Power (>50mW) GaAlAs superluminescent diode is experimentally demonstrated in which an anti-reflective window structure is incorporated to the conventional high power laser diode.

articleTitle: Reflectivity optimizations of semiconductor lasers with coated and angled facets considering two dimensional beam profiles
publicationTitle: 12th IEEE International Conference on Semiconductor Laser
abstract: In this paper a method is developed for the optimization of multilayer anti-reflection (AR)-coatings on semiconductor laser amplifiers (SLA) with finite waveguide widths and angled output facets.
